title: Central Muse MSP session-host protocol subset (1.4.20, offline-exported)
description: Wire surface Central uses for MuseGateway, distilled from the MSP schema export (stable surface, schemaVersion 1, SS1.4.x) and verified live on 1.4.23 via the echo provider (initialize/initialized/session-start/turn-start/turn-completed/tokenUsage/contextUsage). The 2-step approval flow is schema-captured but NOT live-exercised: the gateway must treat unlisted methods/notifications as opaque buffered events, never parsed into domain facts.

provenance.liveHandshakeVerified: initialize/initialized/session-start/turn-start/turn-completed/tokenUsage/contextUsage on 1.4.25 (echo); approval/request + userInput/request + decide/answer not exercised

envelope.transport: JSONL over stdio (one JSON-RPC 2.0 frame per line, UTF-8, LF terminated)
envelope.id: client request ids are numbers or strings; server-initiated request ids correlate with approvalId/userInputId in params

serverRequestReceipt.result: RequestReceipt {} (presentation only, SS5.3.3 — the decision travels as a separate command)

initialize.afterResult: notify `initialized` {} — the host serves nothing before it (live: session/start fails `notInitialized` without it)

result.sandboxAvailability: object (absent means unknown — probe, never invent)

params.commandId: string (UUIDv7, REQUIRED — the server never mints one; de-duplicated retry returns the same result)
params.modelId: string (verbatim, never silently substituted; null accepted by echo)
params.approvalMode: allowAll|promptUnmatched|onRequest|denyUnmatched (select, never create; live: onRequest accepted, echoed back as {mode, source} object)
params.config: only the mcpServers member is admitted
params.workspaceRoot: string (REQUIRED in practice — composes the workspace; a turn whose roots were never composed is rejected `workspace_not_composed`; live: '/tmp' ok)

result.session: Session object (carries the server session id)
result.viewCursor: string (subscribe from here; every later view event arrives after this cursor)

session/resume.source: offline schema: SessionResumeParams/Result (SS2.5.2); reconcile evidence, best-effort

params.commandId: string (UUIDv7 idempotency handle; the turnId derives from it — always take turnId from the ack)
params.workspaceRoots: array (equivalent of the gateway working directory)

turn/cancel.source: offline schema: normal command lane (SS3.5); priority lane is turn/interrupt

params.choiceId: string (one of the current availableChoices, else -32052)
params.requirementId: must equal currentRequirementId — the multi-stage race guard (stale is -32053)

approval/decide.source: offline schema: ApprovalDecideParams (tdd SS5.4); standard SS3 command — durable intake before ack, value-identical replay

params.answers: one entry per question: selectedLabel | selectedLabels (within min/max) | freeText (<=500 chars), plus optional note (<=500)

userInput/answer.source: offline schema: UserInputAnswerParams (tdd SS5.10.2); non-matching answers fail -32057

approval/listPending.result: full pending approval and user-input payloads
approval/listPending.source: offline schema: lease-free fold read (SS5.7); reconcile evidence

params.subject: {kind: shell, command} (what is being approved)
params.availableChoices: [{choiceId, decision, label, scope}] — live: allow_once/approved/once, allow_local_prefix/approvedPolicyAmendment/localPersistent, abort/abort/once
params.currentRequirementId: OBJECT {approvalId, sourceIndex} — travel VERBATIM in decide, never as a string

approval/request.response: RequestReceipt {} ONLY — presentation ack (SS5.3.3). The decision travels as approval/decide.
approval/request.decide: approval/decide {sessionId, commandId UUIDv7, approvalId, choiceId, requirementId (verbatim object), feedback?} — live-verified: abort + feedback accepted, turn cancelled, agent told
approval/request.source: live 1.4.23 (shell approval under approvalMode promptUnmatched; Receipt then decide)

userInput/request.params: UserInputRequestParams (userInputId, questions[{id, header, question, isSecret, options}])
userInput/request.response: RequestReceipt {} ONLY — presentation ack (SS5.3.3). The answer travels as userInput/answer.

turn/completed.note: The turn terminal. Usage here is incidental: the usage SOURCE is session/tokenUsage + session/contextUsage.

session/tokenUsage.note: The usage source (evidence-only, never ledger). `usage`/`cumulative`/`totalTokens` are SIBLINGS — not nested (live shape). Raw counters are verbatim provider facts, not summable across providers.

session/contextUsage.note: Context-occupancy fact; the member is null until a tracked anchor exists (absent is never fabricated).

approval/updated.params: non-terminal approval change to the pending view

approval/resolved.params: first durable approval terminal; protected delivery

userInput/settled.params: first durable user-input settlement; protected delivery

toleratedOpaque.note: Every other method/notification (computerUse*, goal/*, model/*, plugin/*, recap/*, session/*Changed, skill/*, subagent/*, task/*, view/*, workflow/*, monitor/*) is buffered opaquely, never a domain fact.
toleratedOpaque.reconcileReads: session/read, session/list, view/page, view/subscribe, approval/listPending stay best-effort evidence reads
